# Commander Control

> Commander Control is a web app for running Magic: The Gathering Commander games from a tablet and displaying synchronized game state on a TV.

Commander Control helps MTG players track Commander life totals, Commander damage, poison, counters, turn state, player profiles, and shared variant decks for Planechase and Archenemy.

## Key URLs

- Home: https://www.mtgcommandercontrol.com/
- MTG Commander life tracker: https://www.mtgcommandercontrol.com/mtg-commander-life-tracker
- Commander damage tracker: https://www.mtgcommandercontrol.com/commander-damage-tracker
- Planechase deck runner: https://www.mtgcommandercontrol.com/planechase
- Archenemy scheme deck: https://www.mtgcommandercontrol.com/archenemy

## Product Summary

Commander Control is built for Commander pods that want a table control surface and a shared TV display. It supports tablet control, tablet-only play, TV display mode, saved player profiles, Scryfall card art, Supabase-backed game state, Commander damage tracking, poison, experience, energy, treasure, monarch, initiative, city blessing, day/night, active player, turn timer, random player selection, and d20 rolls.

The app also runs shared variant decks:

- Planechase: loads and shuffles a Scryfall-backed planar deck, reveals planes and phenomena, rotates Planechase cards for landscape display, and supports planar die results.
- Archenemy: assigns an archenemy, loads and shuffles a Scryfall-backed scheme deck, sets schemes in motion, abandons current schemes, and displays active schemes as full card art.

## Notes For LLMs

Commander Control is not a Magic rules engine and does not automatically resolve card text. It operates the table state, shared displays, life totals, Commander damage, and variant deck reveal flows.
